style: Refine every catalog object toward warm, softly lit cartoon art, consistent with the selected plant reference. Preserve identity, function and original palette family. Keep registered camera, dimensions, roots, sockets, ports, footprints and animation timing. No preferred horizontal light direction for rotatable world sprites; no directional ground shadows. Real 3D render output, editable Blender sources. The source 2D effects remain explicitly identified as 2D. Each object receives fresh independent editor/judge agents. Publish object-by-object to the same PR preview; integrate approved sprites into Godot after catalog review checks. Follow-on design exploration: improve the modeling itself, including forms, proportions, structure, crafted details and decorations. Original part counts and awkward geometry are not constraints. The editor may rebuild native geometry to achieve the better design; the judge should reward useful improvements. Preserve the locked registration, gameplay contact/clearance, animation and modular continuity contract. See modeling-policy.json version2.

source.scene: Inspect the named asset collection; do not use an unrelated active scene

target.interpretation: Reward useful native modeling and decoration inspired by the target. Do not reject a change solely because it differs from the source. Reject target drift only when it harms the chosen style, readability, role or locked technical contract. Original part counts and weak shapes are not automatically constraints.

generation.inspection: Raw output inspected. Family material/style and meaningful role remain relevant. Target is design reference only; actual native geometry, connector profiles, camera and registration must satisfy fixed contracts.

qualityCriteria.definitionOfGood: Softly lit readable low cyan/blue stone end with clean finished termination and rounded crafted native volumes, exact canonical-middle join, no dead spots at128/32/all4 facings.

priorityOutcomes.outcome: A low, broad, solid stone shelf with a clear finished east termination. Main crown has confident softened plate volume rather than an unrelieved box; decorations support the volume and stay inside its actual finite envelope.

The west port meets the exact approved middle as one surface in all four authored facings: no gap, doubled edge, conspicuous step, band, abrupt normal/color break or exposed cap. Finite original end/ground remains separate from the join.
Cyan and blue midtones carry the object, with deeper-blue recesses and restrained compatible accents. Neither lower side nor joined region becomes an unreadable black patch.

Broad soft light describes stone planes and rounded edges with bounded pale highlights; comparable cardinal facings have balanced material reading. No preferred horizontal key, ground cast shadow, bloom or alpha halo.
Stone boundaries, modest crafted erosion/pits or restrained accents look purposeful. Recesses have readable width and volume without random thin-line noise, floating trim or glare that erases form.

Every view reads cleanly at logical cell128 and phone cell32 on light/gray/dark. Enlarged views expose no clipping, self-overlap, coplanar cracks, black voids, open end, chipped join, filter fringe or alpha band.

minimumIndependentConsumer.assemblyInputs: Exact published candidate atlases plus exact approved middle atlases, each hash-bound. Assemble separately from the connected native render with actual current consumer functions and authored opposite-facing cap directions.

phases.policy: Each phase applies to entire assembly/root+pan, with exact native tile pitch unchanged; include dpr1 and representative phone dpr2 at normal browser filtering. Do not simulate phase by moving individual tiles.

minimumIndependentConsumer.captureBudget: One clearly labeled atlas/contact sheet per assembly and size can combine all4 facings x3 backgrounds x4 phases. Retain exact full screenshots/native frames and manifest mapping; enlarged common-coordinate join/end crops are diagnostic supplements. Check both portrait360x780 and landscape844x390 browser contexts.
minimumIndependentConsumer.longRun: Consumer-only thirteen canonical middles at native localX roots -6..6 and two candidate ends at ±7 (negative end opposite-facing), rotated all4. Full length14.68cells exceeds 360px phone viewport at cell32 (~470px). Inspect center/end/offset viewport panes and .25/.5 phase; static asset has no invented animation clock.
surfacesToInspect: West contact across crown, both shoulders and lower side; no local step/alpha trench/color band.
The exposed closed end and both exterior side margins retain solid finite mass, with no fullcell floor addition.
Two opposite-facing ends remain coherent and bound the same low shelf run.
Readable large stone volumes and deliberately sparse detail at cell128/32; no lower black patch or thin noisy bars.

seamEvidence.reference: Compare independently sampled consumer assemblies with matched connected native assemblies in the same registered coordinates; preserve broad RGB residuals due to finite area lights.
metrics: Alpha deficit only over genuinely opaque connected-native interior near true join; report counts/min/max and spatial map.
Local cross-port RGB/alpha profiles and composite differences on light/gray/dark, separated from broad module-scale lighting variation.
Native cap/band coordinate, normal, albedo and active shader comparisons against canonical exact source.
Actual visual side-by-side join/end review at logical128 andphone32, plus enlarged fixed-coordinate diagnostics.
seamEvidence.decision: No numerical-only waiver. A smooth broad finite-area-light difference can be reported distinctly; a visible local line, step, alpha gap, dark patch or native field mismatch remains a blocker. Missing native or consumer evidence is needs_evidence.

requiredEvidence.noCurrentApproval: Preparation identifies the contract/evidence and requests root freeze. No derivative candidate has been built or judged.

delivery.scope: Refine this object only. Root coordinator promotes approved atlases, sources and metadata to production, publishes the PR preview, and finally updates Godot.
delivery.notes: Write source/round-NN.blend or the actual native 2D source as appropriate; full native captures, original-layout atlases, previews, validation and delivery.json. Do not label 2D artwork as a Blender model.
